Serpent LordPassive
Instant
Augments Spider Form into a Serpent Lord, giving some of your Spider Form abilities a 1 second cast time and 10 yds of increased range.

Damage is increased when attacking an enemy past 10 yds by 30% and spell pushback from enemy attacks is reduced by 50%.

Increases the damage of Withering Venom by 50% and causes it to create a Miasma.
Miasma
Create an 8 yd cloud of poison at a location for 12 sec, causing 57*$+NatP*0.125 Nature Damage to 8 enemies within it every 2 sec.
